title: Kamishiro Rui — Magic and Science Combined〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: ASTRO FES - Day 2
ASTRO FES Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Good. Rehearsals are proceeding smoothly. Everyone is working so well together, you wouldn't think we only just began yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The performance side only needs a few more tweaks. As for what else needs to be checked...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sakasaki.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line:
You want to trial the efFECT, yeS?
Everything's all set herE. Just say the worD.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Then let's not hesitate...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Firing in three, two, one—!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whaa?!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: What was that sound?! Are we under attack by an evil organiza— Wait...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Look at that... Rainbow-colored light is falling from the sky. It's beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Is this a stage effect? Wow...

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Come on, don't just stand there chatting. Back to rehearsal. We have a limited amount of practice time on the stage.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: And you two, maybe let us know beforehand the next time you fire something off?

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Consider it a surprise presENT. I wanted you all to experience the same fresh new excitement our audience wilL.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line:
Is that so? Well, it was pretty, I'll admit that...
Alright, one more time from where we stopped.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Akito & Jun
rows.Line: ーー♪ ーー♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The trial firing was a success. But...)
One hour later
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Phew. Rehearsal went off without a hitch, so now we just wait!

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: I'm sure you all noticed places you could improve. Work on polishing those before we go on!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: Man, Sakasaki and Kamishiro's effects are amazing, huh?

rows.Speaker: Jun
rows.Line: It's astounding they were able to put those together in such a short time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Especially that rainbow explosion! It was so amazing, I stopped right in the middle of our rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that. But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The truth is, there was a problem with that effect.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A problem? It looked as though it went off wonderfully...

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: I'm surE. But all that means is that you were successfully enchantED.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Of course Sakasaki noticed as well.)

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: So, what's wrong with it then?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was only a minor variation, but the air cannon didn't get the range we wanted.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The plan calls for the light to fall upon every seat in the venue. But in the test fire, it didn't reach the seats in the rear.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: UnacceptaBLE.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Our goal here is to bring happiness to every person who's come to see uS. That is Switch's duTY— The duty of a magiCIAN.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sakasaki...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're right. I want this show to bring smiles and happiness to all of our guests. Anything less is unacceptable.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: HaHA, I knew you would aGREE.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Innovation always walks hand in hand with failURE. Let us learn from this mistake and use it to perfect our maGIC.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Well, that sure sounds nice. But are you going to have time to do that?

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: No need to worRY. We have a genius Inventor and a genius Magician herE, after alL.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: When we work togethER, there's nothing we can't dO. RighT, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, certainly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That said... Adjusting the air cannon's specs directly would be difficult. And there's no guarantee a smaller reactant payload would work, either.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What if we incorporated drones?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Drones? You mean...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, the ones I always have with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we synchronize the drones flying to the outer seats with the air cannon, and have them spray the “magic” from their onboard nozzles...

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: I seE. That way the magic will reach everyONE. Do you have the drones' bluePRINTS?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can send you the data shortly... But I'll be equipping them with aerosol-type spray nozzles.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: I'll need to adjust the reactant mixture someWHAT, theN.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Rui, I'll need you to prepare the following for mE.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Astounding... They're in perfect sync.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose we have nothing to worry about with the effects.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Right. Let's trust them to get it done, and do what we can ourselves!
A few hours later - Before the show
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: Thank yoU, Rui. Everything's ready in timE, thanks to your assisTANCE.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No need to thank me. I've learned quite a lot from you today... And we both simply want to see people smile, after all.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: YeS. It's exactly that mindset that makes me happy to work with yoU.

rows.Speaker: Natsume
rows.Line: NoW, soon the curtain will risE. Let's bring our audience a dream that seems so reAL, they'll never believe their eyES♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Together, we'll cast a spell of happiness over them.
